تكتفوا (form VIII)
# تَكْتَفُوا (taktafū) /tak.ta.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِكْتَفَى (iktafā)
# تُكْتَفَوْا (tuktafaw) /tuk.ta.faw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِكْتَفَى (iktafā)
